verdict.rationale: Convex explicitly states it forgoes a built-in RLS/security-rules system, instead letting developers write custom authorization logic directly in TypeScript query/mutation functions ('this flexibility lets you build and use an authorization framework for your needs'). This delivers the underlying capability (per-user data restriction) but via hand-written code rather than declarative row-level security policies, so it's a different mechanism than the story implies. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/examples showing a concrete per-row access-control pattern, reusable policy helpers, or an official authorization library/component demonstrating this in practice.
